Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When describing the patients, add a visible sign of illness to make the danger clearer. Example: “有的病人捂着肚子，脸色很难看。”
2. At the flower, add colour and shape so that the reader can picture what Shen Nong finds. Example: “那是一朵黄色的花，像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”
3. Add Shen Nong’s worried thought after he notices that the plant may be poisonous. Example: “这种植物有毒吗？我得小心一点。”

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete sign of the patients’ illness without repeating the learner’s wording.
This gives the flower a simple visual description and does not change the scene’s events.
This adds Shen Nong’s understandable worry after he suspects that the plant is poisonous.
